transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. I came in today because... well, I keep hearing Garrett’s voice. It's as clear as if he’s standing right behind me when I'm out on the trail, or in my painting room. Even though part of me knows he’s dead, in the moment... it just feels completely real. It's been happening enough that I knew I needed to come in and see someone.
What does Garrett's voice say when you hear him?

Well, like I was saying, it usually happens when I'm on the trail or in my painting room... so he mostly just says normal things about whatever I'm doing. He might comment on the colors I'm using, or tell me to watch my step on the dirt path. It's just... everyday conversation. 

But his voice is so clear. It really is like he's standing right over my shoulder. Even though my rational mind knows he's gone, when he speaks to me... it just feels completely real in that moment.
I'm so sorry for your loss. When did Garrett pass away?
Thank you. He passed away about a month ago. This whole... crisis, I guess you could call it, has been unfolding since then.
Apart from these moments when you hear Garrett's voice, how has your overall mood been since he passed away?

Well, it hasn't been what you would expect. At first, instead of just being down, I actually felt almost... lit up. Like I had this urgent purpose that no one else could see, and I just had to keep moving and getting things done. 

But it wasn't exactly a good feeling, because if anyone questioned me or tried to slow me down, I would just snap. I'd fly into an absolute rage over it. It was just this intense, irritable energy driving me.
Before Garrett passed away, had you ever experienced a period in your life when you felt deeply depressed?
Yeah, actually. Um... the depressed, really shut-down part... that's been going on for about four months now. So, yes, it definitely started a few months before I lost him.
Over the past month, while experiencing that intense energy, have you also continued to feel that deep depression at the very same time?

No, not really. It wasn't at the same time. The depression was there before, but once that intense, irritable energy started up after he died, the heavy, shut-down feeling kind of went away. It was just all that wired energy.
